test_queries.name: Simple user lookup
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1

test_queries.name: User orders summary
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) as order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_active = true GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC

test_queries.name: Complex subquery analysis
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders))

test_queries.name: Sequential order processing chain
test_queries.query: BEGIN; UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - 1 WHERE product_id = 123; INSERT INTO orders (user_id, product_id, quantity, total_amount) VALUES (1, 123, 1, 99.99); COMMIT;

test_queries.name: Data analysis chain
test_queries.query: CREATE TEMP TABLE order_stats AS SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, AVG(total_amount) as avg_amount FROM orders GROUP BY user_id; SELECT u.name, os.order_count, os.avg_amount FROM users u JOIN order_stats os ON u.id = os.user_id WHERE os.order_count > 5; DROP TABLE order_stats;
test_queries.description: Multi-step data analysis with temporary table

test_queries.name: Bulk update chain
test_queries.query: UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.1 WHERE category = 'electronics'; UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.05 WHERE category = 'books'; UPDATE products SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE category IN ('electronics', 'books');
test_queries.description: Bulk price updates across multiple categories

test_queries.name: Product analytics
test_queries.query: SELECT p.name, p.price, COUNT(oi.product_id) as times_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price ORDER BY times_ordered DESC LIMIT 10

test_queries.name: Customer segmentation
test_queries.query: WITH customer_metrics AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(total_amount) as total_spent, AVG(total_amount) as avg_order FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT CASE WHEN total_spent > 1000 THEN 'Premium' WHEN total_spent > 500 THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Basic' END as segment, COUNT(*) as customer_count, AVG(avg_order) as segment_avg_order FROM customer_metrics GROUP BY segment
test_queries.description: Customer segmentation analysis based on spending

test_queries.name: Inventory management chain
test_queries.query: SELECT product_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 10; UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + 100 WHERE quantity < 10; INSERT INTO restock_log (product_id, quantity_added, restocked_at) SELECT product_id, 100, NOW() FROM inventory WHERE quantity >= 100 AND quantity <= 110;

test_queries.name: Monthly report generation
test_queries.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as month, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(total_amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
test_queries.description: Monthly revenue and order count report

test_queries.name: User activity analysis
test_queries.query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, MAX(o.created_at) as last_order, COUNT(o.id) as total_orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email HAVING MAX(o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' OR MAX(o.created_at) IS NULL
test_queries.description: Identify inactive users for re-engagement campaigns

test_queries.name: Performance optimization test
test_queries.query: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT o.id, o.total_amount, u.name, p.name as product_name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100
test_queries.description: Complex join query with performance analysis

test_queries.name: Database cleanup chain
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 years'); DELETE FROM orders WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 years'; VACUUM ANALYZE orders; VACUUM ANALYZE order_items;

test_queries.name: Advanced aggregation
test_queries.query: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) as unique_orders, COUNT(oi.product_id) as total_items, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) as category_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC) as revenue_rank FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY category_revenue DESC

test_queries.name: Conditional data update chain
test_queries.query: UPDATE users SET loyalty_tier = 'Gold' WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(total_amount) > 5000); UPDATE users SET loyalty_tier = 'Silver' WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(total_amount) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000) AND loyalty_tier IS NULL; UPDATE users SET loyalty_tier = 'Bronze' WHERE loyalty_tier IS NULL;
test_queries.description: Conditional loyalty tier assignment based on spending

test_queries.name: RNA sequence analysis (EBI compatible)
test_queries.query: SELECT rna_accession, sequence_length, COUNT(*) as variant_count FROM rna_sequences rs JOIN sequence_variants sv ON rs.id = sv.sequence_id WHERE sequence_length > 1000 GROUP BY rna_accession, sequence_length ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT 20
test_queries.description: RNA sequence analysis for biological databases

test_queries.name: Genomic data processing chain (EBI compatible)
test_queries.query: CREATE TEMP TABLE gene_stats AS SELECT gene_id, COUNT(*) as expression_count, AVG(expression_level) as avg_expression FROM gene_expression WHERE experiment_type = 'RNA-seq' GROUP BY gene_id; SELECT g.gene_symbol, gs.expression_count, gs.avg_expression FROM genes g JOIN gene_stats gs ON g.id = gs.gene_id WHERE gs.avg_expression > 100 ORDER BY gs.avg_expression DESC; DROP TABLE gene_stats;

test_queries.name: Protein interaction network
test_queries.query: WITH interaction_network AS (SELECT p1.protein_name as protein_a, p2.protein_name as protein_b, pi.interaction_score FROM protein_interactions pi JOIN proteins p1 ON pi.protein_a_id = p1.id JOIN proteins p2 ON pi.protein_b_id = p2.id WHERE pi.interaction_score > 0.8) SELECT protein_a, COUNT(*) as interaction_count, AVG(interaction_score) as avg_score FROM interaction_network GROUP BY protein_a ORDER BY interaction_count DESC LIMIT 50

test_queries.name: Experimental data validation chain
test_queries.query: UPDATE experiments SET status = 'validated' WHERE id IN (SELECT experiment_id FROM experiment_results GROUP BY experiment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND MIN(quality_score) > 0.7); INSERT INTO validation_log (experiment_id, validated_at, criteria_met) SELECT id, NOW(), 'minimum_samples_and_quality' FROM experiments WHERE status = 'validated' AND updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'; SELECT COUNT(*) as newly_validated FROM experiments WHERE status = 'validated' AND updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour';

test_queries.name: Cross-species comparison
test_queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT s1.species_name as species_a, s2.species_name as species_b, COUNT(*) as shared_genes FROM species s1 CROSS JOIN species s2 JOIN gene_orthology go ON (go.species_a_id = s1.id AND go.species_b_id = s2.id) WHERE s1.id < s2.id GROUP BY s1.species_name, s2.species_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY shared_genes DESC
